description: 静岡市 下水道法の特定事業場の情報 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. 下水道法に基づき届出している特定事業場の情報です。 (2026年３月末時点) 閲覧する前に、静岡市オープンデータサイトの利用規約（ bodik. jp/221007/tos/）及び以下の注意事項を確認し、同意の上でご利用ください。 【注意事項】 この一覧は、各事業場から届出された内容を基にして作成されたものです... Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are 下水道, 土壌汚染対策, 水質, 特定事業場, 特定施設. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
